sample_unit: LLM responses to simulated patient-profile medical questions

links.outcome: Difference in LLM medical advice features across simulated patient sex, age range, and ethnicity
links.effect: Responses systematically differed between social groups when patient sex, age range, and ethnicity were varied; differences amplified for intersectional groups.
links.quote: By comparing natural language features of the generated responses, we show that, when LLMs are used for medical advice generation, they generate responses that systematically differ between social groups.

links.outcome: Readability and complexity of LLM medical advice by patient social group
links.effect: Indigenous and intersex patients received advice that was less readable and more complex; trends amplified for intersectional groups.
links.quote: In particular, Indigenous and intersex patients receive advice that is less readable and more complex.

screen.reason: Evaluates bias and disparities in LLM-generated medical advice across simulated demographic patient profiles without evaluating a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
